story.summary: Bringing regenerative agriculture into the greenhouse
story.score_reason: Regenerative farming credible, weak Malaysia relevance

carousel.cover_headline:
Regenerative Growing:
Not Changing Everything
Overnight

slides.label: THE IDEA
slides.headline: Healthy plants start with a healthy growing environment
slides.insight: Regenerative growing focuses on the whole ecosystem, not just individual problems.

slides.label: THE SHIFT
slides.headline: Less reacting, more preventing — that is the difference
slides.insight: IPM uses monitoring and prevention before pest pressure becomes a bigger problem.

slides.label: THE BALANCE
slides.headline: Crop quality and **conscious** inputs can work together
slides.insight: Growers examine ingredients, timing and effects on beneficial organisms before applying anything.

slides.label: IN PRACTICE
slides.headline: Small, conscious decisions build long-term farm resilience
slides.insight: Biodiversity and soil health are goals, but solutions must fit existing production systems.

slides.label: TRY THIS WEEK
slides.headline: Observe your plants before reaching for any spray
slides.insight: Check leaves, stems and soil first. Catching problems early is the first step.

sources: Lost Coast Plant Therapy, 2026 (reported by Hortidaily)
carousel.caption:
Regenerative growing: not changing everything overnight.

It starts with understanding the whole ecosystem — soil, biodiversity, and what goes into your growing environment.
For home gardeners, the same idea applies: observe first, intervene mindfully.
Are you already doing any kind of natural pest management at home?

Sources: Lost Coast Plant Therapy, 2026 (Hortidaily)
